name: Avalora Moon-Grove Stagwarden
lore: A living border guardian grown from Avalora memory groves, hostile when foreign forces wound terrain or steal moon-root relics.
visualDescription: Silver antlered guardian, bark-and-moss armor, moonlit leaf mantle, root bow.
mapBehavior: Controls paths with roots and punishes straight-line movement.
